pr_title: Switch the order of adding SNICert and creating LoopbackClientConfig
pr_body:
/kind bug
/sig auth api-machinery
fix https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/101388.

/assign @mikedanese @sttts
Can you take a look? Thank you.

```release-note
none
```
pr_comments:
/lgtm
/approve

I guess what is going on here is that the self client doesn't work right if you don't start apiserver with the right flags? I guess it's fine to fix this.

> I guess what is going on here is that the self client doesn't work right if you don't start apiserver with the right flags?

Sort of. The issue #101388 described the problem in more details. 

From the user's perspective, if they start the apiserver with a main cert provided via the flag (IIRC that's `--server-cert`), they won't trigger the bug. So to most users, this change does not affect them.

And if the user starts the apiserver without the main cert, without this PR, the server will panic as it will wrongly get an empty loopbackClientConfig.

to understand :)

issue_context.title: LoopbackClientConfig is not created when the main cert is empty
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/fe88bdc1ab7957d2e546f602f42d240af2adbcec/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/options/serving_with_loopback.go#L52-L76

The code block does these actions:
1. creating the self-signed cert for loopback connection
2. creating the loopbackClientConfig
3. adding the self-signed cert to the `secureServingInfo.SNICerts`

If the main cert (`secureServingInfo.Cert`) is empty, the loopbackClientConfig will not be created due to this check, https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/fe88bdc1ab7957d2e546f602f42d240af2adbcec/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/config_selfclient.go#L31-L34

loopbackClientConfig shouldn't be left empty, because we have created the SNICert, it's just that we haven't executed action 3 to add the SNICert to the list.

Switching the order of action 2 and action 3 will make the loopbackClientConfig successfully created. 

/kind bug
/sig auth api-machinery
